alex.meaning: No parser-owned source facts, selectors, or owner claims may be inferred from the blocked inventory read.

lean.requiredBeforePass: fresh Lake and AXLE audit with #print axioms

authorityRules: activationGeneration may remain only as configuration/capability/provider-closure observation during migration
activationGeneration is never product, API, CLI, request, publication, admission, cache, or query authority
ASP Server owns the exact content binding and the single publication commit
provider produces stateless parser/project facts and cannot commit identity
same content identity is required for artifact, workspace, source, index, schema, provider catalog, and query admission

serialMigrationOrder.name: ContentIdentity
serialMigrationOrder.gate: typed identity includes all six required digests

serialMigrationOrder.name: ActivationNonIdentity
serialMigrationOrder.gate: activation observation cannot satisfy product/request/publication authority

serialMigrationOrder.name: ExactArtifactWorkspaceSourceIndexBinding
serialMigrationOrder.gate: all bindings share one ContentIdentity and provider catalog digest

serialMigrationOrder.name: ContentPublicationCommit
serialMigrationOrder.gate: one durable commit plus crash-before/after and no mixed observation

serialMigrationOrder.name: ReadinessSelectorIncrementalAdmissionRecovery
serialMigrationOrder.gate: admission and recovery require exact content, not numeric labels

serialMigrationOrder.name: CrossContentAndRollbackCountermodels
serialMigrationOrder.gate: all rejection cases deterministic and fail closed

serialMigrationOrder.name: SchemaNegativesAndRustCrashMismatchTests
serialMigrationOrder.gate: tests cover stale/torn/rollback/cancel/mismatch without sleep-only assertions

serialMigrationOrder.name: LeanAudit
serialMigrationOrder.gate: fresh Lake, AXLE, #print axioms, Rust/schema/RFC mapping

canParallelize: schema negative fixtures after ContentIdentity is fixed
independent crash-cut countermodels after ContentPublicationCommit is fixed
Rust mismatch test harness and proof-file inventory after authority names are fixed
mustSerialize: ActivationNonIdentity before deleting or rewriting epoch authority
all countermodels and Rust tests before retiring old declarations
fresh Lean audit before any public V1 cutover

nextAction: Do not delete or change public V1 semantics. First make the eight-step proof/test plan executable and obtain fresh parser-owned inventory plus fresh Lake/AXLE evidence.
